title_zh: 核对维修公司创办经历和职务称呼

scenario.label_zh: 核对维修公司创办经历和职务称呼
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清公司创办方式与目前职务，并约定文章使用的准确称呼

context_zh: 学生记者采访一家虚构维修公司的创办人，为校刊准备人物介绍。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: What made you decide to found a repair company rather than work for a large manufacturer?

sentences.speaker: Amara
sentences.text: I kept meeting people with useful appliances that nobody would repair. I thought there was a business there.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Did you need an investor to finance the first workshop?

sentences.speaker: Amara
sentences.text: No. I used my own savings, started in a small rented room and bought very little equipment.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Would you describe yourself as an entrepreneur?

sentences.speaker: Amara
sentences.text: Yes, although I still spend more time fixing machines than talking about business.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: For the article, should I call you the founder or the chief executive?

sentences.speaker: Amara
sentences.text: Founder is accurate. We now have a different chief executive who manages the company.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Good. I will identify you as the founder and explain that you still lead the repair team.

sentences.speaker: Amara
sentences.text: That describes my role well. Please send me the dates you want checked before publication.
